name: labs/bgamari__harvard-syringe-pump
title: Harvard Apparatus OEM syringe pump (Model 44)
intro: Harvard Apparatus OEM syringe pump (Model 44), adapted from bgamari/harvard-syringe-pump. It reads `accumulated_volume` and `version`; sets `diameter`, `flow_rate`, `target_volume` and `mode`; runs `start_pump`, `stop_pump` and `set_direction`. `start_pump`: start the pump with its configured flow rate, target volume and mode (RUN); the reply prompt reports the resulting status. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
